info.name: Announcement Banner
info.summary: Display, target, and schedule customizable notification bars across Nextcloud apps and settings pages.
info.description:
Post an announcement banner across your Nextcloud instance to keep everyone informed, or target it to admins, specific groups, and selected apps or settings pages.
**Features** * Multiple banners with overview, status, inline actions, and manual ordering controls. * Audience targeting for everyone, admins only, or specific groups. * Page targeting for selected apps and settings areas, including personal settings and administration settings. * Banners visible on the targeted pages for the selected audience with themed variants (info, success, warning, danger, custom). * Change the order of active banners from the admin overview when several banners are shown at the same time. * Optional schedule with start/end times to control when banners are visible. * Optional dismiss button so users can hide the banner when allowed. * Optional "read more" link with custom label and URL. * Optional translations for banner message and read-more label (fallback to default). * Live preview in admin settings before publishing to everyone. * Changes take effect immediately after saving. * Delegate banner management to specific admin groups via Nextcloud's settings delegation, without granting full server admin rights.
info.author: Mohamed Sakhri
